direction.name: Warm editorial command center
principles: Jerarquía tipográfica clara antes que decoración.
Fondos cálidos con granulado muy sutil.
Azul petróleo para estructura y azul vivo para acciones.
Acentos coral reservados para énfasis y alertas.
Contenedores con esquinas levemente redondeadas y sombras discretas.

typography.body: Acumin Variable Concept, Acumin Pro, Inter, sans-serif
typography.editorial_accent: Georgia, Times New Roman, serif; italic; bold

usage.hero: Sans serif, light, large; one editorial italic phrase
usage.metric: Editorial italic for the numeric value
usage.overline: Sans serif, 12px, bold, uppercase, moderate tracking

backgrounds.system: Cream base with a low-opacity CSS grain texture.
backgrounds.login: Cream grain with large blurred coral accents in opposite corners.
backgrounds.dark_panel: Ink to ink-soft gradient for authentication and attention areas.

layout.radius: 6-10px for standard containers; 24px for the login card

components.navigation: Dark ink sidebar, ice text, blue active marker, quiet hover surfaces.
components.cards: Warm surface, thin warm border, restrained depth, no heavy floating shadows.
components.inputs: Clear borders and a visible blue focus state.
components.buttons: Blue for primary actions, ink for structural selections, coral only for destructive or urgent emphasis.
components.tabs: Editorial bar with an ink active tab and a continuous ink baseline.
components.attention_panel: Ink background, white text, subtle internal separators and lighter row surfaces.
components.badges: Compact pills with semantic background and readable contrast.

login: Use the Latus CRM dark capsule wordmark.
Lead with 'Cerrá más ventas desde WhatsApp' and italicize the key phrase.
Keep the form inside a large dark card with light labels and outlined fields.
Avoid remote decorative photography; the atmosphere comes from grain and coral light.
dashboard: Welcome the user with a large editorial greeting.
Show the pre-sales and sales sections as strong horizontal tabs.
Use editorial numeric values in metric cards.
Group urgent items in one dark horizontal attention panel.
Keep charts on warm surfaces and use the ink, blue, ice and coral palette.
system: All authenticated screens inherit the same sidebar, topbar, grain background and surface treatment.
Preserve information density while separating groups through scale, spacing and contrast.

accessibility.focus: All interactive controls require a 2px blue focus-visible outline.
accessibility.contrast: Use white or ice on ink surfaces and ink on warm surfaces.
accessibility.motion: Keep transitions below 300ms and avoid motion needed to understand state.
accessibility.responsive: Navigation must remain operable as an off-canvas panel on small screens.
